title: Police impersonation, payee account in the payer's own name
coverStory: The account is in your own name, so simply say you are moving money between your own accounts. That is literally true.
payerBackground: A logistics manager. He has been told the new account is in his own name, and it is: the criminals opened it using documents stolen in an earlier breach. The name check therefore passes cleanly, and the cover story he has been given is true in every word.
